Interface PerfDataBuffer

@ThreadSafe public interface PerfDataBuffer
Random access to a block of HKEY_PERFORMANCE_DATA, so the walk over it can live in one place instead of once per native backend.

The walk is entirely offset arithmetic over a flat buffer, identical whichever way the buffer was obtained. Only these three reads differ between JNA and FFM, so they are the whole seam.
